title: arabis hirsuta var. propinqua
intro: Arabis hirsuta var. propinqua, commonly known as Mountain Rock-cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Rock-cress include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Arabis hirsuta var. propinqua, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been reported to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
